what: Ground truth for audio/burst.py. Chatterbox's own voice — phonetics not in doubt — saying "It finds the risk in _ seconds", three seeds per word.
why: th_check could not separate a certain /th/ from a certain /t/ in this position, and had already called "Two" and "Tea" fricatives at the start of an utterance. A measurement that cannot be checked against a known answer is not a measurement.
how_to_regenerate: The audio is generated, not stored. See the note in audio/burst.py; regenerating needs Chatterbox with no audio_prompt_path at exaggeration 0.50, cfg 0.30, temperature 0.75, seeds 0/1/2.
